title: Live Music @ El Hueso de Fraile
event_description: Cozy coffee venue hosting live music performances nightly. Diverse genres from jazz to world music in an intimate candlelit setting. Craft beers and specialty coffee available.
event_venue_information:
Family-run arts and cultural center featuring live performances across multiple genres. Intimate venue with outdoor patio seating.

El Hueso de Fraile Music Venue

Nightly Music Programming

Diverse live music genres from jazz and classical guitar to world and contemporary music. Intimate candlelit ambiance perfect for musicians and audiences to connect.

Amenities

Over 40 craft beers plus specialty coffee and tea. Outdoor patio seating available. BYOB policy. Welcoming staff committed to creating inclusive space for all ages.

title: Live Music @ Mynt Bar and Grill
event_description: Sports bar with regular live music performances. Local bands and performers provide entertainment while patrons enjoy drinks and food. Reasonably priced drinks and casual atmosphere.
event_venue_information:
Mynt Bar and Grill Live Music Venue

Entertainment Features

Regular performances from local bands and solo artists. Music features rock covers and original compositions. Well-designed acoustics allow conversation during performances.

Venue Amenities

Multiple bars throughout space for quick service. Dedicated dance floor. Well-lit and spacious. Late night food service until midnight. Sports viewing on multiple screens. Happy hours and power hour specials.
